title: Fear Not, For I Am With You

questions.question: Listen to me in silence, O coastlands; let the peoples renew their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:1 (ESV): "let the peoples renew their strength;"

questions.question: Who stirred up one from the east whom victory meets at every step?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:2,4 (ESV): "I, the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he."

questions.question: But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the offspring of whom, my friend?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:8 (ESV): "the offspring of Abraham, my friend;"

questions.question: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:10 (ESV): "be not dismayed, for I am your God;"

questions.question: I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:10 (ESV): "I will uphold you with my righteous right hand."

questions.question: The coastlands have seen and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble; they have drawn near and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:5 (ESV): "they have drawn near and come."

questions.question: Everyone helps his neighbor and says to his brother, "Be what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:6 (ESV): "and says to his brother, 'Be strong!'"

questions.question: Fear not, you worm Jacob, you men of Israel! I am the one who helps you, declares the whom?
I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with what?
I will open rivers on the bare heights, and fountains in the midst of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:18 (ESV): "and fountains in the midst of the valleys."

questions.question: I will put in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the what?
Set forth your case, says the LORD; bring your proofs, says the King of whom?
Tell us what is to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods; do good, or do harm, that we may be dismayed and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:23 (ESV): "that we may be dismayed and terrified."

questions.question: I stirred up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, and he shall call upon my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 41:25 (ESV): "and he shall call upon my name;"

questions.question: For I look, but there is no one; among these there is no counselor who, when I ask, gives an what?

key_verse_text: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
